name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ is a Kansas City institution that has earned legendary status for its exceptional barbecue. This signature pack features their famous slow-smoked ribs, tender brisket, and caramelized burnt ends. The ribs are coated in a sweet and tangy glaze that perfectly complements the smoky flavor. The brisket is smoked for hours over hickory wood, resulting in a peppery bark and incredibly juicy interior. The burnt ends are the highlight, offering a crispy, caramelized exterior with a rich, savory taste. This pack is perfect for a barbecue feast.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ brings the authentic taste of North Carolina to your table with their Carolina Oink Sampler. This pack features hand-chopped pork BBQ, smoked sausages, and perfectly seasoned ribs, all slow-cooked over a wood fire. The vinegar-based sauce adds a tangy kick that complements the smoky meat beautifully. This sampler serves 4-6 people and is perfect for anyone wanting to experience true Carolina barbecue. Kings BBQ has been a family-owned tradition for decades.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ has been named the number one brisket in Texas by Texas Monthly, and this offering lives up to that reputation. The brisket is seasoned with simple salt and pepper, then smoked over post-oak wood for 16 hours until it reaches sublime tenderness. The outside develops a dark, peppery crust while the inside remains incredibly juicy and flavorful. This brisket is a true testament to the art of Texas barbecue, where the meat itself is the star. Each slice is cut against the grain to ensure maximum tenderness.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ from Memphis brings you a classic combination of tender ribs and pulled pork in this dinner-for-4 package. The ribs are slow-smoked over hickory wood until they achieve perfect tenderness, while the pulled pork is hand-shredded and mixed with a tangy tomato-based sauce. This pack includes two racks of ribs and over two pounds of pulled pork, along with their famous sauce. Central BBQ has been a Memphis favorite for years, and this combo delivers authentic Tennessee flavor.

name: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
dsc: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque is a Kansas City legend that has been serving exceptional barbecue since the 1920s. Their Barbeque Sampler for 8 is a feast fit for any crowd, featuring burnt ends, sliced brisket, smoked turkey, and pork ribs. All meats are slow-cooked over hickory wood and served with Bryant's signature sweet-and-tangy sauce. This sampler is perfect for family reunions, office parties, or any large gathering. Arthur Bryant's has been named one of the best barbecue joints in America.

name: Franklin Barbecue
dsc: Franklin Barbecue is widely regarded as one of the best BBQ joints in the world. Their Whole Brisket is the reason why, seasoned with simple salt and pepper and smoked over oak wood for up to 18 hours. The result is a deeply smoky, melt-in-your-mouth texture with a dark, flavorful bark. This package includes a whole prime brisket and a bottle of their legendary Texas Barbecue Sauce. Franklin's brisket is the gold standard of Central Texas BBQ, now available for you to enjoy at home.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue is an Austin institution known for its exceptional smoked meats. Their Whole Texas Smoked Brisket is a masterpiece of Southern cooking, rubbed with a proprietary spice blend and smoked over post-oak wood for over 12 hours. The result is a rich, smoky flavor with a beautiful pink smoke ring and a crusty peppery bark. This brisket serves up to 12 people and is perfect for backyard BBQs or holiday feasts. Terry Black's has been serving Central Texas since the 1930s.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ's larger combo pack serves 8 people and includes three racks of ribs and over four pounds of pulled pork. This is the ultimate party pack for Memphis-style BBQ lovers, featuring slow-smoked ribs with a sweet and tangy sauce and hand-pulled pork with a vinegar-based sauce. The pack also includes Central BBQ's signature sauce and reheating instructions. This combo will satisfy even the heartiest appetites and leave everyone asking for more. Central BBQ has been a Memphis staple since 2001.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ is a Los Angeles treasure known for its authentic Texas-style barbecue. Their Mini Trinity Combo brings together three BBQ essentials: brisket, ribs, and sausage links. The brisket is smoked for 14 hours over oak wood, resulting in tender, juicy meat with a beautiful bark. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender with a sweet and smoky glaze, while the sausage links are perfectly spiced and smoked. This combo serves 4-6 people and includes Bludso's signature sauce.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke from New York City offers a delightful combo of baby back ribs and backyard barbecue chicken. The ribs are smoked over cherry wood, giving them a sweet, fruity flavor that complements the tangy BBQ sauce. The chicken is brined, smoked, and grilled to achieve crispy skin with juicy meat. This combo serves 4-6 people and includes two racks of ribs and two whole chickens. Blue Smoke is known for its exceptional barbecue and has been a New York favorite since 2002.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Meat Lovers Special is designed for those who can't get enough of smoked meat. This massive pack includes pulled pork, sliced brisket, smoked sausage, and a full rack of ribs. It serves up to 10 people, making it ideal for large parties and family reunions. Every cut of meat is smoked for hours over a wood fire to lock in flavor and tenderness. The pulled pork is hand-pulled, the brisket is perfectly sliced, and the ribs are coated in a sweet glaze. This is the ultimate BBQ feast for true meat lovers.

name: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q
dsc: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q is a world-championship-winning BBQ joint from Decatur, Alabama. Their 4-pack allows you to select four of their most popular meats, including pulled pork, sliced turkey, smoked chicken, and brisket. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and seasoned with award-winning rubs. This pack serves 4-6 people and includes their famous white sauce, a tangy Alabama specialty. Big Bob Gibson has been serving award-winning barbecue since 1925.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ offers the ultimate Texas BBQ experience with their Best of Texas Combo, which serves up to 14 people. This enormous pack includes two whole briskets, four racks of ribs, and a large portion of pulled pork, all smoked over post-oak wood. The briskets are renowned for their tenderness and rich smoky flavor, the ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, and the pulled pork is juicy and full of flavor. This combo is perfect for weddings, corporate events, or any large gathering.

name: Mighty Quinn's BBQ
dsc: Mighty Quinn's BBQ brings New York-style barbecue to your doorstep with their Sampler Pack. This package includes brisket, pulled pork, spare ribs, and their famous burnt ends, all smoked over a mix of hickory and oak wood. The brisket is tender and full of flavor, the pulled pork is juicy and smoky, and the burnt ends are caramelized to perfection. The sampler comes with their signature sauce and a spice rub. It serves 6-8 people and is perfect for experiencing NYC BBQ.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles is famous for its bold-flavored BBQ. Their Big Ugly Dinner for 6 includes beef brisket, pork ribs, and their signature hot links, all smoked over a custom blend of woods. The brisket is incredibly moist, the ribs are sticky and tender, and the hot links provide a spicy kick. It comes with house-made BBQ sauce and a side of pickles and onions. Ugly Drum has been serving authentic BBQ since 2010 and is a favorite among locals.

name: Southside Market & Barbeque
dsc: Southside Market & Barbeque from Elgin, Texas is known for its legendary smoked meats. Their Post Oak Smoked Half Brisket is made from USDA Prime beef, seasoned with simple salt and pepper, and smoked over post-oak wood for up to 12 hours. The result is incredibly tender meat with a beautiful pink smoke ring and a crusty, flavorful bark. This half-brisket serves 4-6 people and includes house-made BBQ sauce. Southside Market has been a Texas institution since 1882.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint from Ocean Springs, Mississippi offers a true Southern experience with their Ribs & Pulled Pork Dinner for 6. This feast includes two racks of ribs and over three pounds of pulled pork, smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods. The ribs are glazed with a sweet and tangy sauce, while the pulled pork is seasoned with a secret spice blend. The Shed is known for its authentic Mississippi barbecue and live blues music atmosphere.

name: Franklin Barbecue
dsc: Franklin Barbecue's Whole Brisket and Sausage combo is a match made in heaven. The brisket is a masterpiece of Central Texas BBQ, smoked for up to 18 hours over post-oak wood. The sausage is made from premium beef and pork, seasoned with a secret spice blend, and smoked to perfection. This package includes a whole brisket, sausages, and a bottle of their famous Texas Barbecue Sauce. It serves up to 14 people and is perfect for feeding a large group.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue brings you Texas-Sized Smoked Beef Ribs that are absolutely massive and packed with flavor. Each rib is cut from prime beef, seasoned with coarse salt and pepper, and smoked over post-oak wood for up to 8 hours. The result is incredibly tender meat with a rich beefy flavor and a beautiful smoke ring. This pack includes 4 massive beef ribs and serves 6-8 people. Terry Black's is a legendary Austin BBQ joint known for its exceptional quality.

name: Famous Dave's
dsc: Famous Dave's is a household name in the BBQ world. Their Just the Meat BBQ Faves for 6 delivers exactly what you want: premium smoked meat without any fillers. This package includes a whole smoked chicken, a full rack of ribs, a pound of brisket, and a pound of pulled pork. Each meat is smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving it a unique and delicious flavor. Famous Dave's has been serving award-winning barbecue since 1994.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ Rib Tips are a hidden gem for anyone who loves rich, fatty, flavorful barbecue. These rib tips are cut from the ends of pork spare ribs and smoked over oak wood until caramelized and tender. The result is a bite-sized piece of meat packed with smoky flavor and a satisfying chew. This pack serves 10-15 people, making it perfect for large gatherings. Bludso's has been serving authentic Texas-style BBQ in Los Angeles for over a decade.

name: Dinosaur BBQ
dsc: Dinosaur BBQ from Syracuse, New York is famous for its bold, flavorful BBQ. Their Ribs & Chicken Combo Pack includes two racks of pork ribs and two whole smoked chickens, all coated in Dinosaur's signature sweet-and-spicy sauce. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, and the chicken is juicy with crispy, smoky skin. This combo serves 6-8 people and is perfect for family dinners and cookouts. Dinosaur BBQ has been a staple of the Northeast BBQ scene for decades.

name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ's Hog Heaven is a pork lover's dream come true. This package includes a generous portion of their famous pulled pork and smoked sausage links. The pulled pork is slow-smoked for over 10 hours and hand-pulled to preserve its juicy texture. The sausage links are made from premium pork and spices, smoked over hickory wood for a rich, savory flavor. This pack serves 4-6 people and includes Joe's signature sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke's BBQ Sides 4-Pack is the perfect complement to any BBQ feast. This pack includes their famous baked beans, creamy coleslaw, tangy potato salad, and buttery cornbread. Each side is made fresh with high-quality ingredients and authentic recipes. The baked beans are slow-cooked with molasses and bacon, the coleslaw is crisp and refreshing, the potato salad is rich and creamy, and the cornbread is moist and slightly sweet. This 4-pack serves 6-8 people.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint's Pit-Smoked BBQ Ham is a delicious alternative to traditional pork or beef BBQ. This ham is smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving it a sweet and smoky flavor. The ham is then glazed with a sticky, tangy BBQ sauce that caramelizes beautifully. This ham serves 6-8 people and is perfect for holiday dinners, Sunday suppers, or any special occasion. The Shed is known for its authentic Mississippi barbecue.

name: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q
dsc: Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q's 2-pack allows you to select two of their award-winning meats. Options include pulled pork, sliced turkey, smoked chicken, and brisket. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and seasoned with championship-winning rubs. This 2-pack is perfect for couples, small families, or anyone wanting to sample a variety of flavors. It comes with their famous white sauce, a tangy Alabama specialty. Big Bob Gibson has been a world champion since 1925.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Food Explorer Carolina BBQ Pack is a curated selection of their most beloved offerings. It includes hand-chopped pork BBQ, smoked sausage, and a full rack of ribs, along with their signature vinegar-based sauce. This pack allows you to explore the full spectrum of Carolina BBQ flavors, from tangy and sharp to sweet and smoky. The pork is smoked over a wood fire and hand-pulled, while the sausage is seasoned with a secret spice blend. This serves 4-6 people.

name: Micklethwait Craft Meats
dsc: Micklethwait Craft Meats from Austin, Texas offers an incredible BBQ Meat and Sides Feast that serves up to 15 people. This massive package includes two briskets, three racks of ribs, and a large portion of pulled pork, along with generous servings of smoked baked beans, creamy coleslaw, and tangy potato salad. The meats are smoked over post-oak wood and are known for their incredible flavor and tenderness. This feast is perfect for corporate events and large family reunions.

name: Old 300 BBQ
dsc: Old 300 BBQ from Blanco, Texas brings you a Half Texas Smoked Brisket that is packed with flavor. This brisket is made from high-quality Angus beef, rubbed with salt and pepper, and smoked over post-oak wood for 14 hours. The result is incredibly tender meat with a deep smoky flavor and a beautiful bark. It's perfect for smaller gatherings or for those who want to enjoy premium Texas BBQ without buying a whole brisket. This pack serves 4-6 people.

name: Perini Ranch Steakhouse
dsc: Perini Ranch Steakhouse from Buffalo Gap, Texas is known for its mesquite-smoked meats. Their Peppered Beef Tenderloin is rubbed with coarse black pepper and garlic, then smoked over mesquite wood for a bold, smoky flavor. The mesquite imparts a distinct, slightly sweet smokiness that pairs perfectly with the rich beef. This tenderloin is incredibly tender and juicy, making it ideal for special occasions. It serves 6-8 people and comes with reheating instructions.

name: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ
dsc: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ brings you a classic Ribs and Pulled Pork Combo for 4 that is bursting with authentic Tennessee flavor. The ribs are dry-rubbed with a secret spice blend and smoked over hickory wood, then served with a tangy tomato-based sauce. The pulled pork is hand-pulled and mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a delightful tang. This combo includes a full rack of ribs and two pounds of pulled pork. Melissa Cookston is a world champion pitmaster.

name: Dangerously Delicious Pies
dsc: Dangerously Delicious Pies from Baltimore brings you a unique and savory Pulled Pork BBQ Pie that is sure to become a new favorite. This pie is filled with slow-smoked pulled pork, caramelized onions, and a rich BBQ sauce, all encased in a flaky, buttery crust. The filling is sweet, smoky, and savory, with a texture that is both tender and satisfying. This pie serves 6-8 people and is perfect for a potluck, family meal, or any occasion.

name: Southside Market & Barbeque
dsc: Southside Market & Barbeque is famous for its creative and delicious sausages. Their Bacon Wrapped Cheddar Jalapeño Sausage Slammers are a fan favorite, made from premium pork, blended with sharp cheddar cheese and spicy jalapeños, then wrapped in thick-cut bacon and smoked over post-oak wood. The result is a savory, spicy, and smoky bite perfect as an appetizer, snack, or main course. This pack includes 12 slammers and serves 4-6 people.

name: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint
dsc: The Shed BBQ & Blues Joint's larger dinner pack serves 8 people and includes three racks of ribs and over four pounds of pulled pork. The ribs are smoked over a blend of hickory and fruitwoods, giving them a sweet and smoky flavor, while the pulled pork is seasoned with a secret spice blend and smoked until tender. This pack is the perfect choice for bigger parties, family reunions, or any event where you need to feed a hungry crowd. The Shed is a Mississippi favorite.

name: Guy Fieri
dsc: Guy Fieri brings his signature bold flavors to your kitchen with this BBQ Trash Can Nachos and Caliente Margaritas kit. The nachos are loaded with pulled pork, BBQ sauce, cheese, and a fiery blend of spices, all piled high on crispy tortilla chips. The Caliente Margaritas add a spicy kick with jalapeño-infused tequila and fresh lime. This kit serves 4-6 people and is perfect for a fun, lively gathering. Guy Fieri is known for his over-the-top flavor combinations.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Pig Out Party Pack is a massive feast that serves up to 12 people. It includes two racks of ribs, five pounds of pulled pork, two pounds of brisket, and a pack of smoked sausages, along with a bottle of their famous Carolina BBQ sauce. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, the pulled pork is juicy and flavorful, and the brisket is perfectly smoked. This is the ultimate BBQ experience for pork lovers, perfect for parties and tailgates.

name: Meat Mitch
dsc: Meat Mitch from Kansas City offers a KC BBQ Sampler that features all the classics: brisket, burnt ends, pulled pork, and spicy sausage. This sampler is a celebration of Kansas City BBQ, known for its sweet, tangy sauces and slow-smoked meats. The brisket is tender and juicy, the burnt ends are caramelized and smoky, the pulled pork is hand-pulled and flavorful, and the sausage is perfectly spiced. This pack serves 6-8 people and includes Meat Mitch's signature sauce.

name: Underbelly by Chris Shepherd
dsc: Underbelly by Chris Shepherd brings a unique twist to Texas BBQ with their Unconventional Texas BBQ Sampler. This pack includes brisket, pulled pork, smoked sausage, and a special beef cheek, all smoked over post-oak wood and seasoned with a blend of spices that reflect Houston's diverse culinary scene. The brisket is tender and juicy, the pulled pork is smoky and flavorful, and the beef cheek is a melt-in-your-mouth delicacy. This serves 4-6 people.

name: Central BBQ
dsc: Central BBQ's Sauce and Rubs Kit is a must-have for any BBQ enthusiast. This kit allows you to choose three of their most popular sauces and rubs, including their sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce, spicy vinegar-based sauce, and a dry rub perfect for ribs and brisket. Each sauce is made from scratch using high-quality ingredients and Central BBQ's secret recipes. The rubs are a blend of spices that add depth and flavor to any meat. This kit is perfect for those who love to cook.

name: Blue Smoke
dsc: Blue Smoke's Backyard BBQ Picnic for 4-6 is the perfect package for a relaxed outdoor meal. It includes a full rack of ribs, a whole smoked chicken, a pound of brisket, and a pound of pulled pork, along with a selection of their famous sides: coleslaw, baked beans, and cornbread. All the meats are smoked over cherry wood, giving them a sweet, fruity flavor. This picnic pack is ideal for a day at the park, a backyard party, or a family reunion.

name: Jack Stack BBQ
dsc: Jack Stack BBQ from Kansas City is known for its high-quality meats and gourmet sides. Their Best Sellers BBQ Buffet Pack includes a selection of their most popular items: beef brisket, burnt ends, smoked turkey, and baby back ribs. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and served with a side of their famous baked beans, coleslaw, and potato salad. This buffet pack serves 8-10 people and is perfect for large gatherings. Jack Stack has been a KC favorite since 1957.

name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ's Z-Man Sandwich is legendary, and now you can make 8 of them at home with this kit. The Z-Man features tender smoked brisket, melted provolone cheese, and crispy onion rings on a soft Kaiser roll, all served with Joe's sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce. This kit includes 8 Kaiser rolls, 2 pounds of sliced brisket, provolone cheese, onion rings, and a bottle of signature sauce. It's perfect for family dinners, gatherings, or any occasion.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ offers a Smoked Whole Brisket that is unsliced and serves 15 to 20 people. This is the ultimate centerpiece for any large gathering. The brisket is smoked over oak wood for 14 hours, developing a rich, smoky flavor and a beautiful bark. It's left unsliced so you can slice it to your preferred thickness, preserving its juices and ensuring maximum tenderness. This brisket is perfect for weddings, corporate events, or any celebration.

name: Snow's BBQ
dsc: Snow's BBQ brings you Texas-Sized Pork Spare Ribs that are big on flavor and perfect for any BBQ lover. These ribs are seasoned with a simple salt-and-pepper rub and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours, resulting in tender, smoky, and slightly sweet meat. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender with a beautiful caramelized crust. This pack includes 2 racks of ribs, serving 4-6 people. It comes with Snow's signature sauce, which adds a tangy, slightly sweet finish.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Pork Ribs are a Carolina classic, and this 4-rack pack is perfect for feeding a crowd. The ribs are rubbed with a secret spice blend and smoked over a wood fire until fall-off-the-bone tender. They are then coated in a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, slightly sweet flavor. This pack includes 4 racks of ribs, serving 8-10 people. It comes with Kings' signature sauce and reheating instructions. These ribs are sure to be a hit with everyone.

name: Bludso's BBQ
dsc: Bludso's BBQ offers a Smoked Whole Pork Shoulder perfect for serving 10-15 people. This shoulder is rubbed with a secret spice blend and smoked over oak wood for 12 hours, resulting in tender, juicy, and incredibly flavorful meat. The pork shoulder is pulled and mixed with a tangy vinegar-based sauce that adds a delightful brightness. This is the ideal centerpiece for any large gathering, from birthday parties to family reunions. Bludso's is known for its authentic Texas-style BBQ.

name: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ
dsc: Melissa Cookston's Memphis BBQ offers 2 slabs of their famous ribs, a perfect representation of Memphis-style BBQ. The ribs are dry-rubbed with a spice blend, smoked over hickory wood for 5 hours, resulting in tender, flavorful, slightly smoky meat. They are served with a tomato-based sauce on the side. This 2-slab pack serves 4-6 people and is perfect for a family dinner or a small gathering. Melissa Cookston is a world champion pitmaster.

name: Hill Country Barbecue Market
dsc: Hill Country Barbecue Market's Pitmaster BBQ Brisket + Pulled Pork Sandwich Kit for 6-8 is perfect for creating delicious sandwiches at home. This kit includes 2 pounds of sliced brisket, 2 pounds of pulled pork, 8 artisan sandwich rolls, and a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce. The brisket is smoked over post-oak wood, giving it a classic Central Texas flavor, while the pulled pork is smoked over hickory wood. A perfect choice for casual dinners.

name: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
dsc: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque is a Kansas City icon, and their Barbeque Sampler for 12-16 is a massive feast that includes all their signature meats: burnt ends, brisket, pulled pork, smoked turkey, and ribs. Each meat is smoked over hickory wood and sliced to perfection. This assortment is perfect for large family reunions, corporate events, or any celebration where you need to feed a big crowd. It comes with their famous sauce and a variety of sides.

name: 4505 Burgers & BBQ
dsc: 4505 Burgers & BBQ from San Francisco offers The Presidential Smoked Meat Sampler, a feast fit for a leader. This sampler includes a whole smoked brisket, a full rack of pork spare ribs, a pack of hot links, and a whole smoked chicken. Each meat is smoked over a blend of woods and seasoned with 4505's signature spice blend. The brisket is tender and juicy, the ribs are fall-off-the-bone, the hot links have a spicy kick, and the chicken is perfectly smoked.

name: Terry Black's Barbecue
dsc: Terry Black's Barbecue brings you their Original Texas Smoked Sausage, a true Austin favorite. This sausage is made from a blend of premium beef and pork, seasoned with a secret spice blend, and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours. The result is a sausage that is juicy, smoky, and full of flavor, with a satisfying snap when you bite into it. This pack includes 4 links of sausage, serving 4-6 people, and comes with Terry Black's signature sauce.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles offers a unique take on BBQ with their Half Pit-Smoked Pastrami Brisket. This brisket is cured with a blend of spices, then smoked over a custom wood blend until it's tender and full of flavor. The pastrami brisket has a bold, peppery flavor with a hint of garlic and coriander, making it a delicious alternative to traditional BBQ brisket. This half-brisket weighs 3 pounds and serves 4-6 people. Ugly Drum is a local favorite.

name: White Swan BBQ
dsc: White Swan BBQ from Smithfield, North Carolina offers authentic Eastern Carolina BBQ Chopped Pork. This pork is smoked over hickory wood for hours, then hand-chopped to achieve the perfect texture. The meat is mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, sharp flavor that cuts through the richness of the pork. White Swan BBQ has been a North Carolina institution since 1946, serving some of the best chopped pork in the state.

name: Schmidt Family BBQ
dsc: Schmidt Family BBQ from Bee Cave, Texas offers a customizable BBQ Dinner for 4-6. You can choose from a variety of meats, including brisket, pulled pork, and smoked turkey, and sides like coleslaw, potato salad, and baked beans. Each meat is smoked over post-oak wood and seasoned with a traditional Texas rub. The brisket is tender and juicy, the pulled pork is flavorful, and the turkey is moist and smoky. Schmidt Family BBQ has been serving Central Texas since 2012.

name: Guy Fieri
dsc: Guy Fieri's BBQ Pulled Pork Trash Can Nachos are a fun and flavorful twist on traditional nachos. This kit includes everything you need to create this iconic dish at home: tortilla chips, pulled pork, BBQ sauce, cheese sauce, and a blend of zesty spices. The pulled pork is smoked and shredded, then piled high on a bed of chips with a generous drizzle of cheese and sauce. It's then baked until melted and bubbly. This kit serves 4-6 people.

name: 17th Street BBQ
dsc: 17th Street BBQ is a world-championship-winning BBQ joint from Murphysboro, Illinois. Their Grand World Champion BBQ Baby Back Ribs are legendary, dry-rubbed with a secret spice blend and smoked over hickory wood for 5 hours. The ribs are served with a tangy tomato-based sauce on the side. This 4-slab pack serves 8-10 people and is perfect for large gatherings. 17th Street BBQ has won numerous competitions and is a favorite among BBQ lovers.

name: 4505 Burgers & BBQ
dsc: 4505 Burgers & BBQ's Junior Smoked Meat Sampler is a scaled-down version of their famous sampler, perfect for smaller gatherings. It includes a half-rack of ribs, a pound of brisket, a pack of hot links, and a half-chicken. Each meat is smoked over a blend of woods and seasoned with 4505's signature spice blend. The ribs are tender and flavorful, the brisket is juicy, the hot links have a spicy kick, and the chicken is perfectly smoked. This sampler serves 4-6 people.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Hand-Chopped Pork BBQ is the cornerstone of their menu and a true Carolina tradition. The pork shoulder is smoked over a wood fire for 12 hours, resulting in tender, juicy, and incredibly flavorful meat. It is then hand-chopped, not pulled, to preserve the texture and ensure each bite has a perfect balance of smoky, juicy, and slightly crispy bits. The pork is mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, sharp flavor. This pack includes 2 pounds, serving 4-6 people.

name: Goode Co. Barbeque
dsc: Goode Co. Barbeque from Houston is a Texas institution known for its exceptional barbecue. Their Slow Smoked BBQ Ribs Dinner includes two racks of pork ribs that are seasoned with a dry rub and smoked over post-oak wood for 6 hours, then glazed with a tangy sauce. The ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender with a beautiful caramelized crust. This dinner serves 4-6 people and includes jalapeño cheese sausage, coleslaw, and beans. Goode Co. has been serving Houston since 1977.
